# Version 4.157.1 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan driver error handling**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.1 avoids unsafe Vulkan descriptor-pool destruction after allocation failures on Imagination drivers. This Skia m157 servicing fix leaves managed bindings and the native ABI unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer Vulkan out-of-memory handling** — On affected Imagination drivers, Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools after host or device allocation failures instead of destroying them unsafely. Graphite also rejects further allocations through the null pool handle. The workaround deliberately forgoes pool cleanup for safety. ([#5838](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5838))
